title: Multiline Mob, Room and Object Programs
body:
Syntax (Builder or higher with area access):
  mpedit <mob vnum> <greet|speech|fight|death|random|move|give|bribe|entry> [speech keyword]
  mpedit <mob vnum> #<script index>  |  mpstat <mob vnum>
  mpset <mob vnum> <script index> <chance 1-100>
  rpedit <enter|random>  |  rpedit #<index>  |  rpstat
  opedit <item vnum> <get|wear>  |  opedit <vnum> #<index>  |  opstat <vnum>
  rset flags no_wander  (toggle protected NPC roaming destination)

Multiline editor: type one script instruction per line; use /l to list, /c to clear, /a to cancel, /s or a single period to save. Save world when finished.

Branching: if level($n) < 10, or ..., else, endif. Nested branches allowed. Other conditions: rank($n), clan($n), room($n), ryo($n), name($n), hasitem($n, 9101), random(25), ispc($n), direction($d), object($o), bribe($b), hitprcnt($i), health($n), chakra($n), stamina($n), roomflag($r, no_wander), remembered($n, academy_pass).
Commands: say, emote, mpecho, mpechoat, mpechoaround, mpgive, mpheal, mptransfer, mpgoto, mpmload, mpoload, mpforce $n <approved game command> (or legacy mpforce <command>), wait 1-120 (non-blocking), mphealmana/mphealchakra, mphealmove/mphealstamina, mpdamage, mpasound, mpjunk, mpremember, mpforget.
Variables: $n player, $i NPC, $r room, $v mob vnum, $d direction, $o given object, $b bribe amount. Double-dollar $$ emits a literal dollar.

Legacy addprogram remains supported. To remove programs use mset/oset/rset removeprogram with the zero-based index. Give items with 'give <item> <npc>'; offer ryo with 'bribe <amount> <npc>'. All scripts are validated sandboxed data and cannot execute Python, shell commands or privileged commands.
More details: docs/SMAUG_MOB_PROGRAMS.md (shipped with Nindo_mud source).
